name: sakura
subtitle_source: Datsun Ditzler color cards (1971-1972; the 240Z palette is the same for 1970-1973)
notes: Reference model: 3D Sets Model 17 Sakura 240, a replica of the Datsun 240Z (S30, Fairlady Z in Japan). Built from October 1969; sold in the US as the 240Z for model years 1970-1973 (260Z from 1974).

Cards cover the whole Datsun range; only the chips offered on the 240Z (paint codes 901-920 and 110-115) are picked by hand in card_layout.json. The 1970 and 1973 cards show none of the Z chips: the 1970/71 Z colours are on the 1971 card and the 1972/73 ones on the 1972 card.
